description:
## [1.0.3](https://github.com/andersonlucasg3/AppleMusic-DiLink/releases/tag/v1.0.3)

Fix startup crash reported on the BYD DiLink (Android 10): the `WindowInsetsControllerCompat` constructor (`x2.W$a`) no longer executes the `WindowInsetsController`-typed delegate on API < 30 — it initializes the impl/window fields directly, so no missing class is resolved on the legacy path. Also declares `apkFileType = XAPK` and the original APK signing fingerprints (1.0.2 feature).

patches.name: Apple Music DiLink manifest
patches.description: Lowers minSdkVersion from 30 to 29 (Android 10) and removes the portrait lock of MLIChromeTabActivity.

patches.name: Apple Music DiLink support
patches.description: Unlocks landscape rotation, lowers the API floor to Android 10 (API 29), backports the API 30 java/androidx calls and bypasses Play Integrity.

release_notes: Fix startup crash on API 29: the WindowInsetsControllerCompat constructor no longer executes the WindowInsetsController-typed delegate on API < 30 (initializes impl/window fields directly).
